fato_historico: 2015: A terrorist attack on a hotel in Al-Arish, Egypt, kills at least seven people and injures 12 others.
energia_do_dia: Today may invite a deep reflection on how you hold space for peace amidst global turbulence. Just as the world occasionally faces shadows, you are encouraged to cultivate a soft, protective light within. It is a good time to wrap yourself in kindness, focusing on healing and the resilient spirit that binds us all together in unity.
frase_do_dia: Even in the darkest times, your gentle heart remains a beacon of hope.
significado_numero: A spiritual number representing the search for inner truth and deep wisdom.
conselho: Consider creating a quiet corner in your home for meditation and peaceful thoughts.
